## Type

- [ ] `feat/` new feature
- [ ] `fix/` bug fix
- [ ] `docs/` documentation only
- [ ] `refactor/` no behavior change
- [ ] `chore/` dependencies, config, CI
- [ ] Release (`dev` → `main`)
- [ ] Hotfix (`hotfix/*` → `main`, then merge `main` back into `dev`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev` (or `main` only for a release or hotfix)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values committed
- [ ] Docs / README updated if behavior or setup changed
